description: Verifies absence of shift(-1) and forward returns in input feature sets.
Scans for prohibited keywords (signal, buy, sell, target, prediction, label).
Guarantees strict ascending chronological order without time leaps.
Enforces backward-only causality when merging multi-domain matrices.
Verifies macro features are lagged to publication timestamp.
Guarantees scheduled event windows are strictly backward-referenced.
Enforces zero raw article text, zero web scraping, and zero NLP model sentiment.
Preserves warmup NaNs and rejects destructive naive forward-fill operations.
Rejects +inf/-inf and requires values to remain within defined numeric bounds.
